expectedIssues: Bottom nav labels are cut off below the screen edge and a black horizontal bar overlaps the icons
reportedIssues: A stray horizontal line is rendered across the bottom navigation bar, striking through the search (magnifier) icon and extending to the orders (receipt) icon. It looks like a broken divider or misplaced border element rather than intentional design.
The bottom navigation icons appear vertically clipped at the bottom edge of the bar, with no visible labels or safe-area padding beneath them.
Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, which can make their purpose ambiguous (especially the receipt/orders icon) and reduces accessibility for screen reader and low-vision users.
